name: jetski-race
note: the race from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host, on a water with a wave mask; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-beach
note: beached on the sand, nose inland, throttle and stick: the craft drives back to the water in about 3 s (it spun on the spot, 8 s and no metres, before); control: no throttle does not count as driving off

name: jetski-handling
note: the handling, by real input on a software GL: a tighter carve when leaning back, a price for over-steering, the rider working, landings that matter, the course area; each with its own comparison

name: jetski-menu
note: the menus by real input, pad and keyboard: every page and back, pause with restart and quit, championship points, a time trial alone; controls: nothing finished pays nothing, a championship keeps its rivals

name: jetski-sound
note: Cold Sound from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host, on the second course; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-ramps
note: the ramps stand: no pile's foot over the water, the low end always under, the top always clear, at the biggest sea of every difficulty on both courses and both ends of Cold Sound's tide (control: lifted 60 m); the same jump at any moment of the sea (control: decks that tip); computer riders take them, land them and lose no more than 5 points of buoys (control: no one goes for a ramp)

name: jetski-placed
note: everything placed by hand stands on something: a building's whole foot on the ground, what stands in the sea under its lowest water; control: lifted 0.6 m. It failed on 40 of Iron Quay's cranes, lamps and containers hung over the quay's edge

name: jetski-buoys
note: the next buoy from the race camera at 100 m and 150 m on every course, GL and WebGPU on the cart: its height, area and contrast from pictures of one held moment with and without it. Control: the small buoy this replaced must fail

name: jetski-ramp-reach
note: every ramp can be reached from the buoy before it and still make the next buoy on its right side, by the real handling at race speed on the course's biggest sea at Hard. Control: the same ramp moved 90 m aside must fail

name: jetski-races
note: a whole race on every course, nobody stuck, rivals missing no more buoys than recorded; control: a race cut short has not been run

name: jetski-quality
note: a program for everything drawn at every quality on both courses and backends

name: jetski-canyon
note: Red Reach from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-harbour
note: Iron Quay from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-storm
note: Gale Bank from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host; control: a bigger sea must change them
